youtube.title: What are your thoughts on digital ID as it pertains to a social media ban?
youtube.summary: “It’s something that Keir Starmer wanted to do and he’s gone. It was never really an issue in New Zealand. I’m not interested in a digital ID”. RCR’s Tane Webster spoke with Deputy Prime Minister and ACT Leader David Seymour.

youtube.title: What are your thoughts on the electronic road user charges (ERUC)?
youtube.summary: “Believe me, the NZTA are not your problem. I’d worry about Vodafone, I’d worry about Spark, I’d worry about Apple. youtube.title: What is the coalition government doing to revive the oil and gas industry?

youtube.title: Does there need to be more emphasis on teaching New Zealand’s European history in schools?

youtube.title: How do we counter some of the education in schools around climate change hysteria?
